_comment:
'Draw a card then discard a random card. If a card with 6 or more {p} is discarded this way, banish a card from a graveyard.' + printed **Blood Debt**.

DEVIATION FROM THE TRIAGE LIST, which named DISCARDED_CARD_POWER_GTE for the gate: that condition (condition_types.py:1046-1052) reads getattr(event, 'power') - it tests whatever object the ability was DISPATCHED with, and for a PLAY ability that is not the discarded card, so the gate would be false in every real resolution. The verified path is the one DISCARD_RANDOM was built for: its handler (effect_types.py:5013-5030) stores the card actually discarded under the ref 'discarded' - the comment there cites this exact wording family ('If a card with 6 or more {p} IS DISCARDED THIS WAY') - and REF_POWER_GTE (condition_types.py:2090-2118) reads a ref param and tests power >= threshold, any entry of a list ref satisfying it. CONDITIONAL (effect_types.py:3697-3724) evaluates 'when' at branch-run time, i.e. after the discard, matching the release note that nobody has priority mid-resolution.

ORDER: effects run in array order, so DRAW precedes DISCARD_RANDOM precedes the gate ('draw THEN discard').

THE BANISH: mandatory per release notes, from ANY player's graveyard, may be the just-discarded card (which lands in your own graveyard). BANISH (effect_types.py:1301-1417) reads from_zone/player/amount and prompts the controller to pick the card from the chosen graveyard; spelling copied from shipped pen/deep_recesses_of_existence_blue.json. A single BANISH names ONE player's zone, so 'a graveyard' is authored as CHOOSE (effect_types.py:5107-5136, reads amount/options; options are named effect blocks) between the two graveyards.

KNOWN IMPRECISION: CHOOSE cannot make an option unavailable, so with exactly one non-empty graveyard the player can pick the empty side and dodge a banish the release notes call mandatory (both empty forces a pointless prompt but no-ops correctly, since BANISH breaks on an empty pool). A conditional-options mechanism would fix this; flagged rather than approximated further.

PRINTED KEYWORD NOT AUTHORED: BloodDebt fires from the card DB keywords field.
